# /sw:report

Rewrites .quality/report.html: scores over time, screenshots of each step of the key tasks, review findings.

Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`. Talk to the user in the project's report language.

Run from the project root (the folder with `.quality/project.json`):

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sw.mjs" report $ARGUMENTS
```

If Playwright is missing, ask the user whether to run `/sw:browser-setup` (pack cache, not the project).

Then read the JSON the command printed (and the file it names, and the screenshots if any) and tell the user, briefly: what passed, what failed and where, what was not checked. Give the user the path of the report.
